classification: Python integer reference and data preparation, not RTL generation or simulation
input_scope: verified real-QAT top-left8x8x24 output from previous first3 tests; original synthetic RGB
rounding: unchanged nearest-even, signed INT64 products, INT16 pre/SiLU, signed INT8 post
residual: aligned existing scales, signed9 sum [-256,254], sat8 [-128,127], fused branch writeback once
DW_task_packing: same-channel adjacent3 outputs then1 tail; input union15 then9;2 groups per task; missing output lanes zero
PW_task_packing: 3 output channels per task;12 input channels in8+4 lanes;2 groups per task
packing_order: lane0 low byte; weight output-lane first then8 input-lanes; bias lane0 low32bits
MAC_bias: encoded in every group but added only with first; first and last asserted once per task
addressing: logical byte addresses from frozen graph; native128-bit beat=(byte_address aligned down16)/2 plus byte_lane
write_visibility: not proven; byte-address shadow only, no real DMA
failure_policy: reject missing real context, scale mismatch, parameter/source hash mismatch, overflow, duplicate/missing output, nonzero masked lane or address mismatch
